plugins.name: argus
plugins.description: Decision-voyage harness. Clarifies the real question, puts an agent crew to work on real code/PRs/files, verifies their claims, and returns a one-screen Current Bearing: course, why, fog or reef, road not taken, next helm — plus a falsifiable decision contract you later settle against reality (/argus:settle, /argus:log).
